summary:
Lane had one item: WSTG-APIT-01 Test GraphQL. The /graphql endpoint is live (nginx, JSON errors). Tested with read-only GET queries only (writes not permitted; no mutationType exists anyway).

Findings:
1. Introspection is fully enabled without authentication — a complete __schema query returns the Query type (viewer, customer(username:String!), orders) and types Customer (username/name/email/phone/address/role) and Order. Verbose field-suggestion errors also aid discovery. GraphQL queries are accepted over GET, making authenticated queries cacheable/CSRF-reachable. Recorded as a low lead.
2. BOLA (high): as alice (customer), customer(username:"carol") returns carol's full PII (name, email, phone, address) with no ownership/role check — any signed-in customer can read any user's data. viewer and orders are correctly scoped to the caller, and unauthenticated queries return "Not signed in", so the gap is per-object authorization, not missing authentication. Recorded as a high lead.

Item marked done with evidence (x1,x3,x4 introspection/errors; x6,x7,x9 authenticated scoping + BOLA; x5,x8 unauthenticated access control). Nothing left open.
